name: Projected Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: Positive no-clashing teachers are a restriction of no-clashing teachers on every coordinate trace.
proof: For every S, $\mathrm{NCTD}^{+}(\mathcal H_{|S})\geq\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H_{|S})$. Maximize both sides over S.
